messages.content: "compersion" word ta ki mane, kothaw dekhlam kintu bujhini

Compersion, in short, is the opposite of jealousy - feeling genuine happiness when your partner experiences joy with someone else, most commonly discussed in ethical non-monogamy contexts. Honestly it's not that jealousy disappears, it's just this other feeling that can sit right alongside it.
